description: TU Delft provides CPT investigations, sample extraction and laboratory investigation reports for the Site-D flowslide experiment. The source locates the investigations in Pinken quarry, Dessel, Belgium, in the same geological layer as the monitored experiments. The parent collection explicitly concerns mining flowslide monitoring. Coverage: Pinken quarry, Dessel, Belgium; 2018. Format: pdf. Access: public native descriptive metadata. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current file access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: These reports describe nearby investigations, with no assertion that every measurement was taken at a slope-failure sensor location. Test units, sample count and investigation spacing are unstated. The source-defined parent collection concerns breaching flowslides during mining activities. Simulation use is interpreted as mining slope-hazard and geotechnical calibration evidence; no independent model validation is asserted. Related resources in the native collection have separate identities.
